svg.text: PVC SLURRY TO BLOWDOWN TANK D-102
A = SHORT-STOP XV-104, CLOSE XV-101/102/103, FV-103 TO 0,
FORCE TV-110B / FV-120 / FV-130 OPEN. B = CLOSE XV-101/102, FV-103.

1. DESIGN BASIS (REFERENCE CARD): VINYL CHLORIDE IN WATER -> PVC; JACKETED BATCH TANK + REFLUX CONDENSER; 50-70 C, 8-12 bar; ORGANIC PEROXIDE INITIATOR; 200 kt/y -> 7.9 MW (dHp 71 kJ/mol, 8000 h/y). PLANT = 4 x 140 m3 REACTORS R-101..R-104; THIS SHEET = R-101 (OTS UNIT).

2. RECIPE (ASSUMED OTS DESIGN POINT): 60 t DEMIN WATER 55 C + PVA (HV-107), 51 t VCM, INITIATORS A + B (t1/2 1.5 h / 12 h AT 57 C), 57.0 C (GRADE K 67). END POINT = PRESSURE DROP 1.8 bar -> 85 % CONVERSION, 43.2 t PVC, REACTION 5.3 h; CYCLE ~7 h -> 4 x 43.2 t x 8000 / 6.9 h = 200 kt/y.

3. VESSEL D 4.5 m x T/T 7.4 m (141.5 m3), SS-CLAD. SHELL 15.2 barg & FULL VACUUM / 93 C, JACKET 5.2 barg (220 / 75 psi, 200 F). PSV-100 SET 15.0 barg TO DUMP TANK D-103: RUNAWAY / TWO-PHASE RELIEF SIZING TBC (DIERS METHOD).

4. BATCH SEQUENCE (DCS): XV-109 EVACUATE TO <= 0.05 bar a -> XV-101 WATER (FQ PRESET) -> XV-102 VCM (PERMISSIVES: XV-106 SHUT, EVACUATED, WATER >= 95 %, M-101 RUNNING, FI-110 >= 300 m3/h) -> HEAT-UP -> XV-103 INITIATOR AT TI-100 >= 54 C -> REACTION -> END POINT
-> XV-104 SHORT-STOP -> XV-105 / PV-105 DEGAS BELOW 2 barg -> HV-141 N2 PAD (1.5 barg) -> XV-106 DISCHARGE. ALL XV FAIL CLOSED; SEQUENCE SIGNALS NOT SHOWN.

5. E-101: VCM VAPOUR UP AND CONDENSATE BACK DOWN THE SAME 18" NOZZLE. INERTS (N2 / AIR) COLLECT AT THE TOP AND BLANKET THE TUBES (TI-132 FALLS TOWARD CW TEMPERATURE) - VENT WITH HV-135. E-101 CW BY VPC-130 / FIC-130 ON PVC-PID-002 (ANTI-FOAM LIMIT 12 m3/h PER % XI-100).
6. XI-100 = CALORIMETRIC CONVERSION IN DCS = INTEGRAL(JACKET + BAFFLE + E-101 DUTIES - AGITATOR POWER + HEAT STORED) / (dHp x FQ-102).
7. LIC-100 (RADAR) HOLDS THE LEVEL WITH SHRINKAGE-COMPENSATION WATER (FIC-103 IN CASCADE): PVC 1.40 vs VCM 0.85 t/m3 -> ABOUT 20 m3 INJECTED PER BATCH; KEEPS THE JACKET WETTED.
8. SIS I-1..I-6 IN A SEPARATE LOGIC SOLVER (TABLE). SHORT-STOP POT D-105 IS N2-PRESSURISED; SHORT-STOP ONLY MIXES WITH THE AGITATOR RUNNING (< 30 s) - AGITATOR ON EMERGENCY POWER (TBC).
9. LINE SIZES AND MATERIALS PRELIMINARY - TBC BY PIPING. SERVICE CODES: PW PROCESS WATER, VC VCM LIQUID, VG VCM GAS, IN INITIATOR, SS SHORT-STOP, SL SLURRY, NG NITROGEN, CW COOLING / JACKET WATER.
CHULA CHEM. ENG. - PVC REACTOR VER 1 (OTS)
